_comment: Staged rollout config. rollout_start_date is set the day you first publish - the scheduler computes 'days since start' from it to pick the active stage. Edit posts_per_day / windows_et as metrics allow; do not need to touch the workflow file to change pace.
timezone_note: windows_et are in US Eastern local time (America/New_York) and are DST-safe - the scheduler converts them to UTC/IST at run time using zoneinfo, so they stay correct across the Nov/Mar DST switch.
advance_conditions_manual_check: Average view duration on published Shorts is at or above 50% before moving to the next stage
No Content ID claims, community guideline strikes, or 'limited/no ads' flags on recent uploads
No YouTube Studio notice about reused/repetitious or spam content
